title: malveopsis marrubioides
intro: Malveopsis marrubioides, commonly known as the Marrubium-leafed Malveopsis, is a plant species within the Malvaceae family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and aiding in the treatment of fever. The therapeutic actions of Malveopsis marrubioides include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
